success_criteria_results.criterion: Apply pipeline contains all four structural defenses ordered with && short-circuit so the destination is never touched on extraction failure
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Tokenized SOP Step 2 line 59 into the &&-separated sub-commands and verified each defense exists in the correct position
success_criteria_results.details:
Token-by-token decomposition of Step 2 pipeline (in order):
  1. `TMP=$(mktemp /tmp/happy-restart-stage.XXXXXX)` — staging
  2. `cat <markdown> | tr -d '\r' | awk ... | sed '1d;$d' > "$TMP"` — extraction to tempfile (NOT to destination)
  3. `LINES=$(wc -l < "$TMP")` — count
  4. `echo "staged_lines=$LINES"` — observability
  5. `[ "$LINES" -ge 400 ]` — LINE-COUNT GATE (defense 1)
  6. `head -1 "$TMP" | grep -q '^#!/bin/bash$'` — FIRST-LINE GATE (defense 2)
  7. `tail -1 "$TMP" | grep -q '^log "Services:\$SUMMARY_PARTS"$'` — LAST-LINE GATE (defense 3)
  8. `mv "$TMP" /root/bin/happy-restart.sh` — ATOMIC RENAME (defense 4 — destination first touched here, only after all 3 gates pass)
  9. `chmod +x /root/bin/happy-restart.sh`
  10. `echo APPLY_OK`

All 10 sub-commands chained with `&&` so any non-zero exit short-circuits before the next command. The destination touch (`mv`) is at position 8, AFTER all three content gates (positions 5, 6, 7). If extraction emits 0 lines (the prior failure mode), `[ 0 -ge 400 ]` returns false at position 5, the chain short-circuits, and `mv` never runs. The prior failure mode is structurally impossible.

root_cause_verification.rationale:
Prior cycle's failure mode was: awk pattern `/^=== BEGIN ===/,/^=== END ===/` (closed-form three-segment, NO script-name segment) emitted 0 lines because the actual markers contain `happy-restart.sh`. Without atomic-write defense, the empty stdout was redirected to the destination. This redev's apply pipeline corrects ALL THREE root causes independently:
  1. Pattern shape fixed — `^=== BEGIN happy-restart\.sh ===$` (closed-form WITH script-name segment) matches the actual markers (verified by Grep returning exactly 2 hits at lines 121, 527).
  2. Pre-flight verification added — Pre-flight check (1) explicitly runs the same grep against the proposal and asserts the expected output before any apply touches the staging tempfile.
  3. Atomic-write defense added — destination is touched ONLY after all three gates (line-count, first-line, last-line) pass via `&&` short-circuit, with the actual write being an atomic `mv` from a tempfile. Even if the pattern were wrong (it isn't), 0-line extraction would short-circuit at the line-count gate and the destination would NEVER be touched.

The combination makes the prior failure mode structurally impossible. Confidence: high.
